question: Is the Gazebo vs fake-bridge gap for student_L1_best.npz an artefact of FakeBridge ignoring --seed, so that spawn-paired seeds remove most of it?
safety: S0 sim only; no Pi, ssh, deploy, car, wheels or motor; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty
seeding_check: simulation/gazebo/run_policy_episodes.py:113 FakeBridge.reset uses random.Random(seed*1000003+episode); seed=0 reproduces legacy random.Random(episode)

fake.frames: not emitted (frame/decode counters exist only for camera sensing)
fake.decodes: not emitted (frame/decode counters exist only for camera sensing)

gazebo.frames: not emitted (frame/decode counters exist only for camera sensing)
gazebo.decodes: not emitted (frame/decode counters exist only for camera sensing)

gap_success_note: gazebo minus fake = 6 successes in 20 episodes
caveat: The arms are seed-paired, NOT spawn-identical. FakeBridge draws d in [0.5,1.5], bearing +/-0.5 rad, yaw +/-1.0 rad via random.Random. Gazebo draws from LEVELS['L1'] via np.random.default_rng([seed, episode]). Same seed and episode index do not give the same start pose. FakeBridge and the world were not changed. The controller labels also differ (student vs student-shield-none); the shield setting is not verified as the cause. Determinism: matched-config runs are not bitwise reproducible (H-0006: 2803 vs 2616 frames, decode 45.6 vs 48.2), so no bitwise claim is made here.

old_result.note: Predates FakeBridge honouring --seed. Only 10 episodes per arm.

falsifier: gap <= 1 success in 20 supports the prediction; gap >= 2 falsifies it
prediction: With spawn-paired seeds the fake-bridge and Gazebo arms differ by at most 1 success in 20 episodes for student_L1_best.npz.
verdict: FALSIFIED. Gap = 6 successes in 20 episodes (Gazebo 6/20 vs fake 0/20), which is >= 2. The gap survives seed pairing, so the old 0/10 vs 3/10 gap is not explained by FakeBridge ignoring --seed alone. Because spawn distributions differ, this gap cannot be attributed to the plant alone either: it mixes plant/sensing differences with spawn-distribution differences. Attribution needs spawn-identical runs, which the brief forbids forcing here.
